statements.ADDRESS-CANONICAL-PACKING: Each Transfer compliance address plaintext is the canonical ordered packing of the constrained diversified-generator encoding followed by the transmission-key encoding.
statements.ASSET-ID-NONZERO: The action asset identifier is not the zero field element, which is reserved as the indexed-registry structural sentinel.
statements.ASSET-LEAF-HASH: The constrained asset leaf commitment is the domain-separated hash of value, next index, next value, parameter hash, and ring hash.
statements.ASSET-PARAMETERS-HASH: The constrained asset parameter hash binds the detection-key encoding, threshold, slot count, and channels hash in that order.
statements.ASSET-POLICY-KEY-ENCODING: The detection and ring policy-key field encodings are canonical compressions of the corresponding constrained Decaf points.
statements.ASSET-REGISTRY-GAP-ORDERING: When isRegulated is one the asset ID equals the authenticated leaf value; when it is zero the asset ID is strictly between that value and the authenticated next value.
statements.ASSET-REGISTRY-MEMBERSHIP: The constrained asset leaf commitment is authenticated at the claimed position under the public asset-registry anchor.
statements.ASSET-REGULATED-BOOLEAN: The asset-regulation selector is exactly zero or one.
statements.ASSET-RING-HASH: The constrained asset ring hash binds the ring-key encoding, ring ID, policy ID, permission, and resource hashes in that order.
statements.CIR-DUMMY-ORDER-COUNT: For padded NoteReshape inputs, is_dummy = 0 slots form a nonempty real prefix and every remaining fixed input slot has is_dummy = 1.
statements.CIR-SELECTOR-BOOLEAN: Every input is_dummy selector is exactly zero or one; zero means real and one means dummy.
statements.CIR-SHAPE-FIXED: The relation constrains every input and output slot of the selected fixed family and binds that exact arity into its public statement.
statements.COMPLIANCE-ADDRESS-ENCRYPTION: Each Transfer address ciphertext equals the canonical address plaintext plus the domain-separated Poseidon stream derived from the selected tier secret and salt.
statements.COMPLIANCE-AMOUNT-ENCRYPTION: Each Transfer amount ciphertext equals its constrained amount plaintext plus the domain-separated Poseidon stream for that tier.
statements.COMPLIANCE-DETECTION-ENCRYPTION: The detection ciphertext binds the selected issuer secret, EPK encoding, detection salt, asset ID, 32-bit sender and receiver slots, and the threshold flag.
statements.COMPLIANCE-FLAG-BOOLEAN: The internally constrained compliance flag is exactly zero or one. It is not directly disclosed; it is bound through the detection ciphertext and the action statement hash.
statements.COMPLIANCE-METADATA-BINDING: The proof-bound Transfer metadata equals the constrained policy hashes, target timestamp, and four tier salts used by the encrypted transcript.
statements.COMPLIANCE-POLICY-SELECTION: For a regulated asset the effective issuer/ring policy values are the authenticated leaf values; for an unregulated asset every effective policy value is the specified neutral default.
statements.COMPLIANCE-SALT-DERIVATION: Each of the five Transfer salts is the domain-separated hash of the single action nonce root and its fixed tier label.
statements.COMPLIANCE-SHARED-SECRET-SELECTION: Each tier uses the issuer DH secret when the compliance flag is one and the user ACK DH secret when it is zero.
statements.COMPLIANCE-THRESHOLD-FLAG: The compliance flag is one exactly when the asset is regulated and the receiver amount is at least the authenticated threshold; it is zero for every unregulated transfer.
statements.DEC-ACK-DERIVATION: Each compliance ACK point is the effective ring public key multiplied by the corresponding 251-bit user derivation scalar. For a regulated asset the effective key is authenticated by the asset registry and the user point is authenticated by the gated user path; for an unregulated asset the effective key is the fixed neutral ring key and the user point remains circuit-constrained but is not authenticated by user-registry membership.
statements.DEC-AUTHORIZATION-KEY-ENCODING: The externally supplied spend-authorization key coordinates satisfy the deployed Decaf/Edwards curve representation before the key is used by transmission-key or randomized-key relations.
statements.DEC-AUTHORIZATION-KEY-NONIDENTITY: The shared spend-authorization key is outside both affine representatives of the Decaf identity class.
statements.DEC-BALANCE-COMMITMENT-DERIVATION: The derived Decaf balance element is the signed value-generator sum of constrained action values plus the blinding-generator term; any prover-supplied affine representative is required to be Decaf-equivalent, and public use is through quotient-invariant canonical compression.
statements.DEC-BALANCE-COMMITMENT-ENCODING: The public balance-commitment field is the quotient-invariant canonical compression of the circuit-derived balance element or its constrained Decaf-equivalent representative.
statements.DEC-DIVERSIFIED-GENERATOR-ENCODING: Every owner diversified-generator field encoding is the canonical compression of its constrained Decaf point.
statements.DEC-DIVERSIFIED-GENERATOR-NONIDENTITY: Every owner diversified generator used to bind a spend or output is outside both affine representatives of the Decaf identity class.
statements.DEC-EPHEMERAL-PUBLIC-KEY-DERIVATION: Each Transfer tier EPK is the Decaf generator multiplied by that tier's constrained 251-bit ephemeral scalar.
statements.DEC-EPHEMERAL-PUBLIC-KEY-ENCODING: Each public Transfer tier EPK field is the canonical compression of the circuit-derived EPK point.
statements.DEC-INCOMING-VIEWING-KEY-DERIVATION: The constrained incoming-viewing scalar and quotient are exactly the remainder and quotient of Poseidon(ivkDomain, nullifier key, canonical authorization-key encoding) divided by the Decaf scalar order, so the remainder is the unique value in [0, r).
statements.DEC-INCOMING-VIEWING-KEY-NONZERO: The reduced incoming-viewing scalar is nonzero before any diversified transmission-key multiplication.
statements.DEC-RANDOMIZED-VERIFICATION-KEY-NONIDENT: Consensus rejects every fixed spend slot whose serialized randomized verification key is in the Decaf identity class, before spend-authorization signature verification; this applies to real and synthetic dummy slots.
statements.DEC-SHARED-SECRET-DERIVATION: Each issuer and user compliance secret is its effective public point multiplied by the same constrained tier ephemeral scalar used for its EPK. Regulated transfers select registry-authenticated issuer and user facts; unregulated transfers select the fixed neutral detection and ring defaults while the user point remains circuit-constrained but is not authenticated by user-registry membership.
statements.DEC-SPEND-RK-DERIVATION: For every real spend with is_dummy = 0, the claimed randomized-key point is Decaf-equivalent to the authorization key plus the slot randomizer times the generator; public use is through its separately constrained quotient-invariant canonical compression.
statements.DEC-SPEND-RK-ENCODING: Every fixed spend slot's public randomized-key field is the canonical compression of its constrained randomized-key point.
statements.DEC-TRANSMISSION-KEY-DERIVATION: The NoteReshape shared-owner or Transfer/Withdrawal sender transmission point is Decaf-equivalent to its nonidentity diversified generator multiplied by the derived incoming-viewing scalar; public and note-hash use is through quotient-invariant canonical compression.
statements.DEC-TRANSMISSION-KEY-ENCODING: Every note-owner transmission-key field is the quotient-invariant canonical compression of its constrained point; Transfer's receiver point is registry-authenticated only when the asset is regulated. For an unregulated Transfer it remains constrained by the receiver note and ciphertext relations but is not authenticated by user-registry membership.
statements.DEC-TRANSMISSION-KEY-NONIDENTITY: Every note-owner transmission point used by a note commitment is outside both affine representatives of the Decaf identity class.
statements.DUMMY-AMOUNT-ZERO: When an optional input has is_dummy = 1, that slot's constrained note amount is zero.
statements.DUMMY-NULLIFIER-DOMAIN-BINDING: When an optional input has is_dummy = 1, its public nullifier is the family-domain-separated synthetic hash of the constrained dummy seed, slot randomizer, and fixed slot discriminator.
statements.DUMMY-SLOT-POSITION-BINDING: Every synthetic dummy-nullifier preimage includes the canonical constant index of the fixed slot in which it appears.
statements.EXT-ANCHOR-CONTEXT-BINDING: The action anchor accepted by the proof verifier equals the anchor selected for the enclosing transaction.
statements.EXT-ANCHOR-LIVENESS: The state-transition checker accepts the action only while its proof-bound SCT anchor remains live.
statements.EXT-ASSET-ANCHOR-CURRENT: Transfer and Withdrawal execute only against the current accepted asset-registry anchor.
statements.EXT-ASSET-REGISTRY-AUTHORIZED: The accepted asset-registry root is reachable only through authorized policy admission and update transitions.
statements.EXT-ASSET-REGISTRY-KEY-VALIDITY: Every policy leaf admitted under the Transfer asset anchor has valid nonidentity detection and ring public keys with canonical encodings.
statements.EXT-BODY-PROJECTION-CANONICALITY: Consensus decoding admits one authoritative canonical fixed-shape action-body projection; wrong arity, unknown families, malformed encodings, and stale cached body projections are rejected.
statements.EXT-COMPLIANCE-ANCHOR-LIVE: The state-transition checker accepts the action only while its proof-bound user-compliance anchor remains live.
statements.EXT-FIXED-SHAPE-DECODE: Canonical action decoding yields exactly the input, output, signature, and auxiliary-record arity of the selected fixed family.
statements.EXT-HONEST-COMPLIANCE-NONCE: Honest Transfer construction uses one unpredictable nonce root that is unique across all ordinary and fee-funding actions in the enclosing transaction.
statements.EXT-HONEST-COMPLIANCE-TIER-SCALAR-NONZER: Honest Transfer construction rejection-samples every compliance-encryption tier scalar until it is nonzero. This is a wallet-side privacy guarantee; a malicious sender that deliberately discloses its own plaintext is outside the accepted-language claim.
statements.EXT-INPUT-COMPLIANCE-EMPTY: Transfer and Withdrawal acceptance requires every input note's retired compliance ciphertext surface to be empty.
statements.EXT-NULLIFIER-ATOMIC-TRANSITION: The action-local proof-bound nullifier batch is prevalidated and inserted as one typed transition, with no partial nullifier insertion when that batch rejects. Rollback after a later action or executor failure is the separate transaction-runtime obligation.
statements.EXT-NULLIFIER-DISTINCTNESS: The required and optional fixed-slot nullifiers are unequal, including when the optional slot is dummy.
statements.EXT-NULLIFIER-FRESHNESS: Every fixed-slot proof-bound nullifier, including a synthetic dummy nullifier, is absent from committed state before acceptance.
statements.EXT-NULLIFIER-TX-UNIQUENESS: Given an externally supplied complete committed-effects envelope, every target action proof-bound nullifier occurs in its complete transaction nullifier list with the target multiplicity, and that list has no duplicates. This does not prove typed action provenance for arbitrary remainder entries.
statements.EXT-OUTGOING-VIEW-BINDING: Every real and synthetic output key is wrapped under the exact aggregate balance commitment serialized in its action body, and outgoing recovery succeeds under that same commitment.
statements.EXT-OUTPUT-COMPLIANCE-ENCODING: Transfer output compliance ciphertext and metadata records decode canonically to the exact fixed proof-bound V17 surface, with retired fields rejected.
statements.EXT-OUTPUT-PERSISTENCE: Given an externally supplied complete committed-effects envelope, every occurrence of an accepted target action output commitment occurs in its complete transaction output list with at least the target multiplicity, and that complete list is the multiplicity-exact durable output extension modulo storage ordering. An arbitrary remainder may contain an equal commitment. This makes no append-order, SCT-position, or typed arbitrary-remainder provenance claim; rejection is a separately tested runtime obligation.
statements.EXT-PLAN-BOUNDARY-CANONICALITY: Honest wallet plan construction and checked plan decoding admit one authoritative fixed-shape set of canonical spends, outputs, membership facts, blinding values, sender context, and payload fields. The private plan is not a consensus input.
statements.EXT-PROOF-CANONICAL-ENCODING: Serialized proof bytes have the exact deployed length, decode without trailing data or point-encoding aliases, and reserialize byte-for-byte to the same canonical Groth16 proof.
statements.EXT-PROOF-FAMILY-KEY-SELECTION: Verification selects the deployed verifying key identified by the decoded fixed family, with no cross-family key fallback.
statements.EXT-PROOF-VERIFICATION: Groth16 verification succeeds for the serialized proof and the exact native-projected public input under the already-selected deployed verification key.
statements.EXT-PUBLIC-INPUT-PROJECTION: The verifier's sole public field is the native domain-separated hash of the decoded action fields in the same order and fixed width as the circuit statement.
statements.EXT-REGISTRY-WELL-FORMED: Every accepted indexed asset registry has canonical positions, strict successor ordering, and a valid zero-valued structural sentinel.
statements.EXT-SPEND-AUTH-SIGNATURE: A spend-authorization signature over the enclosing transaction effect hash verifies under every fixed-slot randomized key, including dummy slots.
statements.EXT-TIMESTAMP-FRESHNESS: Consensus rejects target timestamp zero independently of block time and rejects a negative signed consensus block time before conversion; a nonzero proof-bound target timestamp is accepted only inside the inclusive fixed ±3600-second drift window around the current consensus time.
statements.EXT-TRANSACTION-BINDING-SIGNATURE: Every transaction containing at least one shielded proof has a nonidentity aggregate action-and-fee balance key and a binding signature that verifies over the final authorization hash. The identity-key all-zero signature sentinel is reserved exclusively for transactions containing no shielded proofs.
statements.EXT-TRANSACTION-EFFECTS-ATOMICITY: Given an externally supplied complete committed-effects envelope, its nullifier and output lists bind the exact durable final multiplicity-preserving multiset extensions on commit, modulo storage ordering and without asserting append order or SCT positions. Rejection rollback is not Lean-derived: the runtime must discard both the state transaction and every reviewed application-owned deferred buffer, as established by mandatory executor tests.
statements.EXT-TRANSFER-EFFECT-HASH-COMPLIANCE-BIND: The canonical Transfer effect hash commits the exact ordered proof-bound output compliance ciphertext and metadata records. Only the witness anchor is normalized out of that hash and is independently bound by EXT-ANCHOR-CONTEXT-BINDING.
statements.EXT-USER-REGISTRY-AUTHORIZED: The accepted user-compliance root contains only authorized canonical address/asset/policy admissions valid at their admission transition.
statements.EXT-WITHDRAWAL-ACTION-ATOMICITY: Given externally supplied complete committed-effects and Withdrawal-effects envelopes, every target Withdrawal balance effect, event, and change-output occurrence is included with at least its target multiplicity, while the exact target packet and sequence advance persist in transaction-final state. Arbitrary remainder effects may equal a target effect, so this is not a typed provenance claim for them. Rejection rollback is a separately tested executor obligation.
statements.EXT-WITHDRAWAL-CHANNEL-CONNECTION-VALID: The exact local channel exists, is open, unordered, negotiated as ics20-1, has exactly one connection hop, and names an existing open connection and counterparty channel committed by the withdrawal payload.
statements.EXT-WITHDRAWAL-CHECKED-TOKEN-FRESH: Immediately before mutation, the non-forgeable checked-withdrawal token is revalidated against the exact channel and connection snapshots, same client identifier, current active and unexpired client state, route, complete policy snapshot, allocated send sequence and empty packet slot, and packet.
statements.EXT-WITHDRAWAL-CLIENT-ACTIVE-UNEXPIRED: The light client and its latest consensus state selected by the checked connection are present, the client is active and unexpired, and the consensus timestamp is not later than withdrawal execution.
statements.EXT-WITHDRAWAL-EFFECT-HASH-BINDING: The four proof-bound 128-bit limbs are the consecutive little-endian chunks of the canonical Withdrawal body effect hash.
statements.EXT-WITHDRAWAL-PAYLOAD-PROJECTION: The validated outbound payload projects exactly to the asset, amount, effect-hash limbs, route, timeout, and address mode bound by the Withdrawal action.
statements.EXT-WITHDRAWAL-PAYLOAD-VALID: The outbound Withdrawal payload has one canonical encoding, and decoding rejects every deprecated compatibility or otherwise noncanonical encoding rather than normalizing it; its amount and timeout are nonzero, its timeout is exactly minute-rounded, and transparent-address mode requires a canonically transparently encodable return address.
statements.EXT-WITHDRAWAL-ROUTE-AUTHORIZED: When a current native asset policy exists, it authorizes the exact effect-hashed outbound channel, denom trace, and destination route; any nonempty regulated compliance memo has the sole canonical wrapper shape and embeds that same withdrawn asset ID.
statements.EXT-WITHDRAWAL-STATE-TRANSITION: Given an accepted target action and externally supplied complete Withdrawal-effects envelope, every target local-asset credit or returning-voucher debit and event occurrence is included with at least its target multiplicity, while the exact proof-bound packet, canonical event attributes, and sequence advance persist without route or value substitution. Arbitrary remainder effects may equal a target effect. This is a conditional transaction-final model; focused runtime and two-chain real-proof tests establish the executor join.
statements.EXT-WITHDRAWAL-TIMEOUTS-FUTURE: The counterparty height and timestamp are both strictly before the effect-hashed withdrawal timeouts at execution.
statements.EXT-WITHDRAWALS-ENABLED: The chain's shielded ICS-20 withdrawal state machine is enabled at the action's execution height.
statements.FIELD-AUTH-RANDOMIZER-RANGE: Every fixed input-slot authorization randomizer, including a dummy slot's synthetic-nullifier randomizer, is a canonical field value strictly below 2^251.
statements.FIELD-BALANCE-BLINDING-RANGE: The action balance blinding is represented by a canonical field value strictly below 2^251.
statements.FIELD-DETECTION-SLOT-RANGE: The sender and receiver detection slot identifiers are each canonical integers strictly below 2^32.
statements.FIELD-EPHEMERAL-SCALAR-RANGE: Every Transfer compliance tier ephemeral scalar is a canonical field value strictly below 2^251.
statements.FIELD-USER-DERIVATION-RANGE: Every constrained user-registry derivation scalar is a canonical field value strictly below 2^251.
statements.FIELD-USER-POSITION-RANGE: Every constrained user-registry path position is a canonical integer strictly below 2^32.
statements.NOTE-OUTPUT-ASSET-BINDING: Every output note commitment uses the action's single constrained asset identifier.
statements.NOTE-OUTPUT-COMMITMENT: Every fixed output commitment is the domain-separated note commitment of its constrained owner, asset, amount, and blinding.
statements.NOTE-OUTPUT-OWNER-BINDING: Every output commitment uses its constrained canonical owner; change and NoteReshape outputs use the sender/shared owner and Transfer's receiver output uses the independent receiver owner.
statements.NOTE-RECEIVER-AMOUNT-NONZERO: Transfer's receiver output amount is not zero.
statements.NOTE-SPEND-ASSET-BINDING: Every real input note commitment uses the action's single constrained asset identifier.
statements.NOTE-SPEND-COMMITMENT: When an input has is_dummy = 0, its constrained private note-commitment intermediate is the domain-separated commitment of the constrained owner, asset, amount, and blinding. It is bound transitively through the public SCT anchor and nullifier into the statement digest; no real-note opening is asserted when is_dummy = 1.
statements.NOTE-SPEND-NULLIFIER-DERIVATION: When an input has is_dummy = 0, its public nullifier is the domain-separated nullifier of the constrained nullifier key, note commitment, and SCT position.
statements.NOTE-SPEND-OWNER-BINDING: Every real input note commitment uses the canonical constrained shared or sender owner whose key material also derives its nullifier.
statements.PUBLIC-STATEMENT-BINDING: The circuit's sole public field equals the exact family-domain statement transcript over every ordered proof-bound action field.
statements.ROUTING-PARAMETERS: Every proof binds one public routing parameter-set identifier to the regulated precision, unregulated precision, and activation height, enforces both precisions in the 0..32 range, and enforces regulated precision no greater than unregulated precision.
statements.ROUTING-TAG-DERIVATION: Every public routing tag is exactly 32 bits and is proof-derived from the canonical transmission-key field, the privately selected class precision, and the nonce-derived random suffix. Transfer also proof-binds the private two-slot permutation, filler rule, and encrypted slot-to-role mapping.
statements.SCT-SPEND-MEMBERSHIP: When an input has is_dummy = 0, its constrained note commitment is authenticated at its constrained position under the public SCT anchor; the membership equality is disabled only when is_dummy = 1.
statements.USER-COMPLIANCE-LEAF-HASH: Each constrained user leaf is the domain-separated six-field hash of the diversified-generator encoding, transmission-key encoding, asset ID, policy slot, derivation scalar, and d value.
statements.USER-COMPLIANCE-MEMBERSHIP-GATE: When isRegulated is one, each constrained user leaf is authenticated under the public compliance anchor; when it is zero, membership is not required but the leaf fields remain constrained.
statements.USER-LEAF-ADDRESS-BINDING: Each user-compliance leaf uses the exact constrained sender or receiver diversified-generator and transmission-key encodings.
statements.USER-LEAF-ASSET-BINDING: Each user-compliance leaf uses the action's constrained asset identifier.
statements.USER-LEAF-POLICY-SLOT-BINDING: Each user-compliance leaf uses its constrained policy slot and slot derivation values without an alternate prover-chosen copy.
statements.VALUE-AMOUNT-128-RANGE: Every constrained spend and output amount is a canonical integer strictly below 2^128.
statements.VALUE-CONSERVATION: For the action's single asset, constrained real input amounts minus constrained output or outbound amounts equal the value coefficient encoded by the circuit-computed balance commitment.
statements.VALUE-THRESHOLD-128-RANGE: The authenticated compliance threshold is a canonical integer strictly below 2^128.
statements.WITHDRAWAL-INTENT-FIELD-BINDING: Withdrawal's public statement binds the outbound asset, outbound amount, and four proof-supplied effect-hash fields in their exact fixed order; value validity and byte-chunk provenance are external acceptance obligations.
